Design system · Harbor Navy

The Fix Spark component sheet

Every token and component the repair site is built from, on one page: surfaces, type steps, buttons, cards, price rows, forms and the dark band set. Nothing here is a separate library — the specimens below use the production classes and the same stylesheet as the homepage.

Colors Typography Actions Layout Pricing Forms Dark surface

Tokens

Color is a role, not a mood.

Surface area per screen is roughly 70% white and mist, 15% teal, 10% navy and no more than 5% amber. Steel is dark-surface only, teal is light-surface only, and amber never appears as text, link or border.

Typography

Two families, ten steps.

Plus Jakarta Sans carries every heading, label and price; Inter carries body copy. Tracking turns negative above 32px, and prices always use tabular figures so columns do not shift.

Actions

Amber means call.

One amber button per viewport, reserved for the phone. Filled navy is the primary action, outline is secondary, and the text link stays teal without an underline until hover.

The badge carries the Google mark, so the source of the rating is obvious at a glance. The amber tint is the only decorative amber on the page besides the stars; text inside stays navy, never white (inside a dark theme --brand-primary flips to white, so use --accent-on).

Layout

A 4px grid and three elevations.

Spacing runs on a 4px base, radii step from 4px to a pill, and depth never exceeds a hairline border plus one soft lift. When in doubt, subtract a box.

Published pricing

Price rows are one component.

Service name left at 16px, range right at 24px navy with tabular figures, 56px rows and hairlines only. The diagnostic row is the single tinted row on the board.

Proof

Case and review cards.

Cases caption the area, brand and date above the fault, then put the invoice price bottom-right. Reviews keep the quote at 16px and the source at 13px muted.

Accordions

Answers open in place.

Native details/summary rows: 16px 600 question, a teal plus that becomes a minus, and a mist background once open.

Do you charge for the diagnostic visit?
Yes. The diagnostic is $89 and it is credited toward the repair if you go ahead. We give you the repair price before any work starts, so you can decide with the number in front of you.
How fast can you come out?
Same-day visits are usual when you call before noon across all four service zones. If a part has to be ordered, you get the ETA before we leave, and we schedule the return visit at that price.

Dark surface

Components on Harbor Navy.

Add data-theme="dark-surface" to the band and the on-dark ramp takes over: white text, steel metadata, raised navy fills and hairline borders. Chips and steel text belong here and nowhere else.
